templates.name: meal_booking_notice
templates.text:
Hello Hungry Exabytians,

We are officially retiring the *Meal Deal Makers* WhatsApp group and upgrading to a smarter, sleeker solution (because typing your lunch order into a chat is _so_ 2025).

From now on (starting from tomorrow's breakfast), please lock in your meal bookings here:
👉 https://exameal.empexaura.com

Please place all future meal bookings through the new portal—your stomach will thank you, and so will our admins!
